_about: Facts used in the report narrative. Each fact is paraphrased (no long quotes) with the source, URL, publication date and the copy kept in source_data/. Company filings are the primary source; news is used for industry, competition and broker reactions. Collected 1-Nov-2026.

facts.text: India's largest paint and decor company; consolidated turnover Rs 35,516 cr in FY2026; operations in 14 countries with 25 paint plants, selling in 60+ countries (brands incl. Apco Coatings, Asian Paints Berger, Causeway, SCIB, Taubmans, Kadisco).
facts.source: Asian Paints Q2 FY27 press release

facts.text: In-house decorative paint capacity 2,290,000 KL a year from 13 in-house plants plus 30 outsourced processing centres; R&D spend Rs 124.9 cr; 181 patents filed; 33,000+ people.
facts.source: Asian Paints Integrated Annual Report FY2025-26 (value-creation model)

facts.text: Sales to 72,873 dealers/distributors in FY2026 (75,793 in FY2025); dealers/distributors take 99% of sales and the top 10 only 0.9%; about 6,000 new retail touchpoints added in FY2026.
facts.source: Asian Paints Integrated Annual Report FY2025-26 (BRSR principle 1, MD&A)

facts.text: International segment revenue Rs 3,354 cr in FY2026, up 9.4%, led by South Asia.
facts.source: Asian Paints Integrated Annual Report FY2025-26 (MD&A)

facts.text: Home decor: 74 Beautiful Homes stores/studios; kitchens, bath fittings, White Teak lighting, Weatherseal windows. Q2 FY27 bath revenue Rs 94.0 cr (+18.5%, PBT Rs 8.7 cr), kitchen Rs 110.3 cr (+13.0%, loss Rs 7.9 cr).
facts.source: Asian Paints Q2 FY27 investor presentation and press release

facts.text: Industrial coatings JVs with PPG: PPGAP (auto OE, refinish, marine) Q2 FY27 revenue Rs 794.8 cr (+33.7%), PBT Rs 112.9 cr; APPPG (protective, powder) Rs 374.5 cr (+28.0%), PBT Rs 17.2 cr.
facts.source: Asian Paints Q2 FY27 press release

facts.text: Q2 FY27 consolidated net sales Rs 9,953.9 cr (+16.9%); PBDIT Rs 1,557.1 cr (+3.6%), margin 15.6% (-202 bp); PBT Rs 1,477.8 cr (+6.2%); PAT after minority interest Rs 1,067.6 cr (+7.5%). Revenue from operations Rs 9,976.5 cr.
facts.source: Asian Paints Q2 FY27 results and press release

facts.text: H1 FY27 consolidated net sales Rs 20,475.3 cr (+17.4%); PBDIT Rs 3,725.8 cr (+19.1%), margin 18.2%; PBT Rs 3,573.5 cr (+23.2%); PAT after minority interest Rs 2,606.9 cr (+24.5%).
facts.source: Asian Paints Q2 FY27 press release

facts.text: Decorative India volume growth 6.4% and value growth 14.5% in Q2 FY27; domestic coatings value +16.4% on volume +6.8%; industrial coatings value +31.8%; international +29.5% (+23.7% in constant currency).
facts.source: Asian Paints Q2 FY27 press release

facts.text: Standalone gross margin fell to 40.3% (-339 bp) as higher-cost inventory flowed through after steep Q1 inflation; calibrated price increases of about 12% partly offset it; consolidated gross margin 39.6% (-349 bp).
facts.source: Asian Paints Q2 FY27 investor presentation

facts.text: A further round of staggered price increases is being taken in decorative paints to counter sustained raw-material inflation and availability constraints linked to geopolitical disruption.
facts.source: Asian Paints Q2 FY27 press release (MD & CEO Amit Syngle)

facts.text: Phase 1 of the VAE (vinyl acetate ethylene emulsion) plant at Dahej commissioned in Q2 FY27: 150,000 MT a year, about Rs 1,060 cr gross block; VAM (100,000 MT) follows in phase 2; total capex about Rs 3,250 cr.
facts.source: Asian Paints Q2 FY27 investor presentation

facts.text: Interim dividend Rs 5.75 a share for FY27 (FY26: interim Rs 4.50 + final Rs 23.00 = Rs 27.50). H1 payout about 21.4%.
facts.source: Asian Paints Q2 FY27 investor presentation

facts.text: New products contribute about 18% of revenue; rural demand led urban in Q2; distribution footprint widened.
facts.source: Asian Paints Q2 FY27 investor presentation

facts.text: Outlook: raw-material inflation, supply volatility and elevated competitive intensity keep the near term challenging; priorities are festive demand, brand and innovation spend, calibrated pricing and cost efficiency.
facts.source: Asian Paints Q2 FY27 investor presentation

facts.text: Q2 FY27 call (summary): H1 decorative volume about 8% and value about 16%; price increases of about 7% in Q1 and 5% in Q2 against about 3% further inflation in Q2; FY27 EBITDA margin guidance of 18-20% kept; VAE expected to give a 300-500 bp cost advantage on relevant products.
facts.source: GuruFocus via Yahoo Finance, Q2 FY27 earnings call highlights

facts.text: Q4 FY26 call: cost inflation estimated near 20% against about 11% price increases passed on; 18-20% EBITDA margin band maintained; FY27 ambition of 8-10% volume growth; discounting by existing and new players shows no let-up.
facts.source: Asian Paints Q4 FY26 earnings call transcript (call 29-May-2026, filed 3-Jun-2026)

facts.text: The company said the Q2 FY27 audio recording and transcript would be uploaded to its website and the exchanges; no transcript was on NSE/BSE when data was collected, so the call is covered from the recording-link filing and press summaries.
facts.source: Asian Paints filing (audio recording link), 29-Oct-2026

facts.text: After Q2 FY27, brokers cut targets: Jefferies Buy, Rs 3,025 (from 3,350); Goldman Sachs Sell, Rs 2,375 (from 2,725); Systematix Buy, Rs 2,885 (from 3,285); Dolat Capital Buy, Rs 2,870 (from 3,320). Systematix expects a 3.5% hike from 1-Nov and another 3-4% later in November (19-20% cumulative since April) and H2 FY27 gross margin down 120 bp YoY.
facts.source: The Economic Times

facts.text: Business Standard: Q2 FY27 net profit up 7.5% to Rs 1,067.6 cr as strong sales were partly offset by raw-material costs and margin pressure.
facts.source: Business Standard

facts.text: The domestic paint industry was estimated at about Rs 77,500 cr as of March 2025 (Rs 75,000 cr a year earlier); infrastructure, autos and real estate support long-run demand.
facts.source: Kansai Nerolac Q4 FY26 press release (industry outlook)

facts.text: Industry estimates put Asian Paints' decorative share at about 59% around March 2024 and about 52% by early 2025, with Birla Opus at 6.8% then.
facts.source: Financial Express (8-Sep-2026); ET CFO (13-May-2025)

facts.text: Asian Paints held an estimated 59% share of Indian decorative paints around the March 2024 quarter (industry estimates).
facts.source: Financial Express

facts.text: Grasim says Birla Opus doubled revenue in FY26, reached about 10% standalone revenue share of decorative paints within two years of launch and is No. 2 by capacity.
facts.source: BusinessWorld (Kumar Mangalam Birla at Grasim)

facts.text: Birla Opus capacity of 1,332 million litres a year from six greenfield plants, about 24% of organised decorative capacity (Rs 10,000 cr investment announced).
facts.source: Grasim, paints business page

facts.text: Grasim's paints revenue was Rs 1,661 cr in Q1 FY27, up 64% YoY and 17% QoQ.
facts.source: NDTV Profit
facts.file: source_data/news_and_macro/2026-08-13_NDTVProfit_BirlaOpus_Q1FY27.md (site blocked the download; link and summary kept)

facts.text: JSW Paints completed the purchase of a 60.76% stake in Akzo Nobel India from AkzoNobel on 10-Dec-2025, becoming promoter; the combined business is the No. 3 decorative player.
facts.source: JSW Group press release; Free Press Journal (11-Dec-2025)

facts.text: Akzo Nobel India was renamed JSW Dulux Ltd, effective 11-Mar-2026, after Ministry of Corporate Affairs approval.
facts.source: ET BrandEquity

facts.text: Pidilite entered decorative paints with Haisha Paints in select regions, aimed at price-point gaps.
facts.source: ET BrandEquity

facts.text: Dealers report steep discounts to clear stock as secondary sales lag supplies since August 2026, while incumbents defend share against Birla Opus and JSW Dulux.
facts.source: Moneycontrol

facts.text: India reimposed anti-dumping duties of USD 460-681 per tonne on specified titanium dioxide imports from China for five years (notified 24-Oct-2026). TiO2 is the main white pigment in paint.
facts.source: The Economic Times

facts.text: The June-September 2026 monsoon delivered about 87% of the long-period average, the weakest since 2015.
facts.source: The Hindu

facts.text: The Competition Commission of India ordered a Director General investigation into Asian Paints (Section 26(1)) on Grasim's complaint of abuse of dominance (dealer exclusivity, supplier restrictions). The Supreme Court declined to hear Asian Paints' challenge in Oct-2025. No final order found as of 30-Oct-2026.
facts.source: CCI order; ET LegalWorld (2-Jul-2025); ET BrandEquity (14-Oct-2025)

facts.text: Supreme Court refused to entertain Asian Paints' plea against the CCI probe.
facts.source: ET BrandEquity

facts.text: Sustainability (FY2026 -> H1 FY27, FY2030 target): renewable electricity 57% -> 62% (100%); Scope 1+2 emissions per KL down 69% -> 71% (80%); fresh-water replenishment 5.9x -> 8.9x (6.0x); recycled plastic in packaging 40% -> 50% (60%).
facts.source: Asian Paints Q2 FY27 investor presentation

facts.text: FY2026: CSR spend Rs 114.6 cr; 9.45 lakh painters and contractors trained; renewable share of electricity 56.5%; statutory auditor Deloitte Haskins & Sells LLP.
facts.source: Asian Paints Integrated Annual Report FY2025-26
